This shard covers Section 6.01(b)(14) clauses (c), (d) and (e), plus the free-standing exceptions (15), (16), (17)(i)-(ii), and (21)(a)-(c). Clauses (a) and (b) of 6.01(b)(14), and exceptions (18)-(20), are owned by other shards and were not compiled here; they are preserved only as dependsOn cross-references (Section 6.01(b)(14)(a), Section 6.01(b)(14)(b)) per instructions.

Clauses (c), (d) and (e) of Section 6.01(b)(14) are mutually alternative gates for permitting the same underlying acquisition/investment-related Indebtedness (per the 'or' connectors and clause (e)'s own 'solely to the extent not permitted in reliance on clauses (a) through (d)' language); this alternative relationship is modeled via dependsOn (ALTERNATIVE_TO / LIMITED_BY) rather than as a shared dollar cap, since (c) and (d) are non-dollar qualitative/ratio gates and only (e) carries an actual dollar-denominated ceiling.

The Fixed Incremental Amount referenced in clause (e)(2) has its own internal cross-references to Sections 6.01(b)(12)(b), 6.01(b)(1)(Z), the General Lien Basket Reallocated Amount and the Available RP Capacity Amount (which in turn nets out other baskets' usage); these are not separately re-modeled as rules in this submission but are preserved via a dependsOn note, since the Fixed Incremental Amount is consumed here purely as a DEFINED_TERM_REFERENCE.
